name: Arun Icecreams Double Chocolate Crunch
ingredients_raw: DOUBLE CHOCOLATE FLAVORED ICE CREAM WITH DARK CHOCO COATING & TOPPED WITH CASHEW NUTS. Inner Layer (60%): Ice Cream (Milk Solids, Sugar, Water, Cocoa Solids (4.5%), Liquid Glucose, Emulsifiers (471, 477), Stabilizers (410, 412), Color (150d) & Artificial (Vanilla) Flavoring Substances). Outer Coating (40%): Dark Choco Coating (Sugar, Fractionated Fat (Sal, Palm & Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin)), Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Butter, Milk Solids, Edible Vegetable Oil (Sunflower Oil), Emulsifiers (322 & 476) & Artificial (Vanilla) Flavoring Substances) & Cashew Nuts (6%). Contains Milk, Nuts & Soy. Manufactured in the same facility which processes Wheat & Oats.
